interest: A reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and demonstrates departmental innovation
expectation: MVP demo in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 delivered within the 200 USD cash budget.

interest: Successful project delivery meeting academic standards without schedule or cost overruns
expectation: Expects timely decision sign-offs from the sponsor within 5 working days and dedicated 8 hours weekly from each student.

interest: Hands-on engineering experience, clear technical guidance, and fair evaluation
expectation: Expects stabilized MVP requirements by week 4, clear task assignments, and weekly progress reviews.

interest: A responsive and engaging in-class quiz experience without timer or connection glitches

interest: Reduced grading workload and real-time insight into student lecture comprehension
expectation: Expects an intuitive quiz authoring dashboard and automated grade export in CSV format ready for week 14 pilot testing.

interest: Stable deployment, low maintenance overhead, and predictable resource utilization
expectation: Expects a deployment checklist and production docker-compose configuration two weeks before the pilot.

interest: Compliance with campus network security and seamless WebSocket proxy traffic
expectation: Expects WebSocket port specifications and traffic load estimates submitted by week 3 to verify proxy configurations.

interest: High engineering quality, complete lifecycle documentation, and rigorous testing
expectation: Expects traceable git commits, automated test coverage exceeding 80%, and an MVP demonstration in week 7.

interest: Student data privacy compliance and local hosting with clear retention rules
expectation: Expects a one-page data description before the pilot with authority to veto live deployment if privacy rules are breached.

interest: Selling proprietary quiz platform licenses to the department if custom build falls short
expectation: Expects benchmark quote requests and evaluation against commercial terms during the business case review at week 7.
